faq: Do you work from a Figma file or only from a template?

Either. Send a Figma, Sketch or image design and we build it as drawn. If you have no design, pick a Webflow template or describe the look you want, and we set one up around your logo, colors and fonts.
Whose Webflow account is the site built in?
Yours. You create the workspace and add us as a member, or we guide you through it. We never ask for your password. Your Webflow site plan and hosting are billed by Webflow directly to you.
Can I edit the site myself afterwards?
Yes. We build with the Editor in mind, so text, images and CMS items can be changed without opening the Designer. Every order ends with a short written guide that shows you how.
Do you write the copy and make the images?
We place the text and images you send. Where content is missing we use clear placeholder text and mark it in the handover, so you know exactly what still needs adding before launch.
